messages.author: ef6cfc9d15fea2d1
messages.subject: Error of fitting model
parts:
Hi INLA help,

I am running to fit the INLA model,

# Model formula
formula.chl <- (chl ~ -1 + Intercept + f(field_chl, model=spde_chl, group=field_chl.group, control.group=list(model="ar1")))


# Fit model with INLA
mod.mode.chl <- inla(formula.chl,
                     data=inla.stack.data(stack.est.chl, spde=spde_chl),
                     family="gaussian",
                     control.predictor=list(A=inla.stack.A(stack.est.chl), compute=FALSE),
                     control.compute=list(cpo=FALSE),
                     keep=FALSE,
                     verbose=TRUE,
                     debug=TRUE,
                     safe=FALSE,
                     control.inla=list(reordering="metis"))

However, there is some error. Sorry I am not sure what information is useful, so I put the output in the attached file.

Many thanks for your help.

Cheers,
Ke
